items.summary: Rescan with the fixed scan_nvidia: LICENSE_NVIDIA at the repo root is the NVIDIA Source Code License for instant neural graphics primitives (non-commercial). The project is review-passed with no licence discussion in notes; a person must rule whether the NSCL-covered code affects tier standing and upstream contribution. UPSTREAM ANSWER (2026-08-26): the author states src/bvh.cu, include/gpu/triangle.cuh, and include/gpu/bounding_box.cuh borrow code from instant-ngp and LICENSE_NVIDIA was included for them; author open to a rewrite. Scope question answered; severity raised -- derived code is in the core, compiles on AMD, and our merged PR #33 touched bvh.cu.

Round-2 rewrite (c7379c0) regresses sdf_raystab +21-23% at 2M tris and +6-9% at 10k tris, and ray_trace +6-11% at 2M tris, on wave32 gfx1151; gfx90a wave64 saw neither. Query-kernel tuning was done on wave64. Correctness gates all pass. Rule: send back to porter for wave32 tuning, or accept and disclose. SECOND wave32 DATA POINT (linux-gfx1100, W7800, 2026-08-26): sdf_raystab regresses at every scale (+10-12% at 10k, +7.5-9.7% at 200k, +6% at 2M); ray_trace +8-15% at 10k/200k but -4 to -7% (faster) at 2M; VGPR cliff identical (174/173, 8 waves). The throwaway amdgpu_waves_per_eu(16) fix (67/88 VGPR, 16 waves, 0 spills) makes both kernels FASTER than pre-rewrite at every scale on gfx1100 (raystab -6 to -9%, ray_trace -4.5 to -18% vs old) with no med200k penalty. Fix confirmed on both wave32 parts with the same attribute value; remaining unknowns are the wave64 gfx90a effect and the CUDA-path guard. H1 (#pragma unroll 1 on the two ray_intersect fan-out loops) also confirmed on gfx1100: 71/73 VGPR, 16 waves, raystab -11 to -16% vs pre-rewrite at every scale and 2.5-10.7% better than the attribute; ray_trace ties the attribute. H1 is arch-neutral and is the fix to send to the porter.

decided.note: Superseded: root-caused to the two #pragma unroll lines and fixed by fc56751, which is faster than the pre-rewrite code on both wave32 parts.

items.summary: Root cause of the wave32 perf regression is the two '#pragma unroll' lines on the fan-out-4 child loops in ray_intersect (VGPR 172->70, 171->73, occupancy 8->16 waves). Changing them to '#pragma unroll 1' makes the rewrite FASTER than the pre-rewrite code everywhere (big2m sdf_raystab -12.4%, med200k -19.6%). Similarity vs e5a657a provably unchanged (pragma lines are excluded from the metric). Decide: apply guarded by USE_ROCM (conservative, CUDA path untouched) or unguarded; either moves head_sha and forces fleet revalidation.

decided.note: Directed in session 2026-08-26: use the unroll fix. Shipped unguarded as fc56751 on moat-port; review-passed and validated on windows-gfx1151 at 191b020.
